article_title: Alstom to build new battery-electric train fleet

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A plan to build 29 battery-electric trains in Derby for TransPennine Express services
A decision to close every railway factory in Derby
A new underground railway connecting Manchester and London
A trial replacing passenger trains with electric buses
tasks.correct_answer: A plan to build 29 battery-electric trains in Derby for TransPennine Express services
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בהזמנה של 29 רכבות חשמליות־סוללה שייבנו במפעל אלסטום בדרבי וישמשו את TransPennine Express.

tasks.prompt: When are the new trains expected to enter service?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: העבודה אמורה להתחיל ב־2028, אך הרכבות צפויות להיכנס לשירות בשנת 2034.

tasks.prompt: What does “fleet” mean in the phrase “the fleet will transform journeys”?
options: A railway station
A manufacturing contract
A group of trains operated together
A route across the Pennines
tasks.correct_answer: A group of trains operated together
tasks.explanation_hebrew: fleet בהקשר זה הוא צי — קבוצה של רכבות המופעלות יחד.

tasks.prompt: Which journey is expected to become up to 14 minutes shorter?
options: Liverpool to Scarborough
Manchester to Leeds
Manchester Airport to Saltburn
Manchester to York
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי משרד התחבורה, זמן הנסיעה בין מנצ'סטר ליורק יתקצר בעד 14 דקות.

tasks.prompt: Why is the order especially important for Alstom's Derby factory?
options: It supports jobs after 1,300 positions had recently been placed at risk
It allows the factory to move from Derby to China
It ends the need to manufacture trains in Britain
It replaces a cancelled contract for London buses
tasks.correct_answer: It supports jobs after 1,300 positions had recently been placed at risk
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מזכירה כי זמן קצר לפני חוזה קודם עמדו 1,300 משרות במפעל בסכנה; ההזמנה החדשה תומכת ביותר מ־350 משרות באלסטום.

tasks.prompt: What does “step-free boarding” mean in the article?
options: Passengers must reserve every journey in advance
Passengers can board without a gap or step between platform and train
The train will stop at fewer stations
Only wheelchair users may enter through certain doors
tasks.correct_answer: Passengers can board without a gap or step between platform and train
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מגדירה step-free boarding כביטול המרווחים בין הרכבת לרציף, כדי להקל על העלייה לרכבת.

tasks.prompt: Describe the timetable, location and ownership arrangement for the new trains.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין מתי מתחיל הייצור, מתי הרכבות נכנסות לשירות, היכן ייבנו, מי יקנה אותן ולמי יוחכרו.
expected_points: Work is due to begin in 2028
The trains are expected to enter service in 2034
They will be built at Alstom's Litchurch Lane factory in Derby
Rock Rail will buy the trains
The trains will be leased to TransPennine Express

tasks.prompt: Explain how the project is intended to benefit both passengers and employment.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין השיפור בשירות לנוסעים לבין ההשקעה והמשרות במפעל ובשרשרת האספקה.
expected_points: Journey times should fall on key northern routes
Capacity is expected to increase by 30%
Thousands of additional seats are planned each day
The trains are promised to be quieter, smoother and more reliable
More than 350 Alstom jobs are supported
A further 6,000 UK supply-chain jobs are supported

tasks.prompt: Summarise the train order, its main passenger benefits and its economic importance.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את ההזמנה, לוח הזמנים, השיפור הצפוי לנוסעים והתרומה למשרות.
expected_points: The order covers 29 Adessia Stream battery-electric trains
The investment is worth almost £1bn
They will be built in Derby and enter service in 2034
They will serve routes across northern England
Capacity and journey times should improve
Accessibility, luggage space and Wi-Fi are promised
The project supports Alstom and supply-chain jobs

tasks.prompt: Write a short passenger announcement explaining what the new fleet will change, without suggesting that the trains are already in service.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב הודעה ברורה באנגלית בלשון עתיד, עם לוח זמנים, אזורי שירות ושיפורי נוחות ונגישות.
expected_points: Use future language because service begins in 2034
Mention that 29 trains are planned
Identify northern TransPennine routes
Mention shorter or more reliable journeys
Include at least one accessibility feature
Include Wi-Fi, luggage, cycle or buggy storage
Avoid claiming the trains are currently operating
